skript.thema: Is your LG smart TV listening? What researchers found and how to switch it off

teile.name: Hook
teile.text: Your TV is off, yet it may be recording. Awkward for your couch. But the muted microphone is weirder.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: the black-haired man in a black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses sits on a sofa in a dim apartment at night, staring warily toward a switched-off television. Medium shot, cool blue light.

teile.name: Claim
teile.text: Gamers Nexus, Level1Techs and three researchers say they captured audio from a dark-screen LG TV whose main microphone was muted.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: researchers in a cluttered workshop lean over a workbench with laptops and a dark television, headphones on, intense focus. Wide shot, moody desk-lamp lighting.

teile.name: Reconnect
teile.text: They say a TV unplugged from ethernet uploaded stored audio after reconnecting. Creepy, if true. So what's LG's reply?
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: a hand pushes an ethernet cable into the back of a dark television in a dim workshop, a researcher watching with raised eyebrows behind. Close shot, cool lamp light.

teile.name: LG's answer
teile.text: LG disputes this: recording needs the voice button, or Hi LG with Far-Field on. Unrecognised audio gets deleted.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: a woman in a bright living room holds a TV remote near her mouth to speak while the television glows softly behind her. Medium shot, warm daylight.

teile.name: Switches
teile.text: Either way, limit tracking. Switch off ACR, Far-Field voice recognition and interest-based ads. Yes, a settings scavenger hunt.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter in a leather jacket scrolls with a remote, squinting at a TV across the room, comically exasperated. Medium shot, cozy evening lamp light.

teile.name: Do Not Sell
teile.text: Then enable Do Not Sell My Personal Information, off by default. Your dark TV? Alleged, disputed, better locked down.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: the presenter in black leather jacket and cyan glasses leans back on the sofa with a relieved smile, remote lowered, the dark TV calm in front of him. Wide shot, soft warm light.

teile.name: Call to action
teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter gives a friendly nod toward the camera in a softly lit living room, dark TV behind him. Medium shot, warm lighting.

skript.beschreibung: Researchers allege LG TVs captured audio even with a dark screen; LG disputes this. Here are the settings Decrypt lists to limit tracking.

belege.name: LG defends smart-TV features amid audio surveillance allegations (10.09.2026)
belege.text: Gamers Nexus released a 135-minute investigation, produced with Level1Techs and independent security researchers; Al Jazeera has not independently verified its claims. The researchers said they recorded audio through an LG TV while it was in hibernation, and that a second microphone, such as the one in the remote, might stay active even when the TV microphone is switched off. Unmatched wake-word audio could allegedly be transcribed into text, stored locally and uploaded to LG servers later. LG says voice data is recorded only when a user holds the voice button or says "Hi LG" after enabling Far-Field voice recognition, that audio is deleted if the wake word is not recognised, and that automatic content recognition, voice recognition and interest-based advertising are separate opt-in features that can each be disabled in the settings.

belege.name: Your LG TV Might Still Be Listening to You, Even When It Looks Like It Is Off
belege.text: Gamers Nexus, with Level1Techs and three security researchers, found that LG TVs scan home networks via UPnP and map connected devices. They captured microphone audio from a TV with a dark screen and from a TV whose main microphone was muted; a TV unplugged from ethernet uploaded stored audio after reconnecting. LG disputed the claims: voice data is processed only after the voice button or the "Hi LG" wake word, ACR is opt-in, network scanning is a standard smart-TV function. To limit tracking: disable ACR, turn off Far-Field voice recognition and interest-based advertising, and enable "Do Not Sell My Personal Information", which was off by default.
